intro: Keeper Remulos is a demigod son of Cenarius and the venerable protector of Moonglade. Alongside Archdruid Fandral Staghelm and Hamuul Runetotem, he helps guide the Cenarion Circle in the absence of his fallen father and the sleeping Malfurion Stormrage. Unlike Staghelm, Remulos prioritizes the broader balance of nature over night elven isolationism.

p: Keeper Remulos is an immortal keeper of the grove, bearing the lower body of a great stag and the antlered torso of an ancient dryad-father. He watches over Moonglade, the sacred sanctuary of Azeroth's druids nestled north of Mount Hyjal. While Malfurion Stormrage remains trapped in the Emerald Dream, Remulos provides divine authority and counsel to the mortals of the Cenarion Circle. He remains deeply invested in healing Azeroth's scars, offering aid to druids pursuing their sacred rites around Lake Elune'ara.

Remulos frequently finds himself at ideological odds with Archdruid Fandral Staghelm. While Staghelm champions night elven supremacy and sought to restore their lost immortality through Teldrassil, Remulos vehemently opposed the planting of the new World Tree as an act of hubris. Defying Staghelm's isolationist faction, Remulos welcomed Hamuul Runetotem and the tauren into the Cenarion Circle, sharing nature's closely guarded mysteries with their shamans-turned-druids to restore the land collectively.
